instruction: Use View > Master > Slide Master to enter the Slide Master, find the slide number, and change it to green font color

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Final paraphrase with green - 'enter the Slide Master' phrasing. The evaluator uses the existing check_page_number_colors function to verify green color in slide master XML.
metadata.verification: The improved check_page_number_colors function searches for the page number placeholder by its semantic identifier (placeholder type 'sldNum') rather than using positional indexing. It iterates through all slide masters in the presentation and locates the page number placeholder by checking the placeholder type attribute. Once found, it extracts the text color from the placeholder's text properties (checking both run properties and default run properties). The function validates the color using threshold-based RGB comparison (red: R > G+50 and R > B+50, blue: B > G+50 and B > R+50, green: G > R+50 and G > B+50, black: R < 50 and G < 50 and B < 50). This approach is more robust and works across different PPTX templates.
